test_camera_timestamps_no_delay: test TriFingerPlatform camera timestamps with zero camera delay steps and verify observation sync
test_camera_timestamps_with_delay: test TriFingerPlatform camera timestamps with a configured camera delay of one or more steps
test_camera_observation_timeindex_bounds: test that get_camera_observation rejects negative time indices and out-of-range time indices
test_object_pose_observation: test TriFingerPlatform object pose observation by setting an initial pose and verifying camera observation values
test_camera_delay_exceeds_rate: test TriFingerPlatform when camera delay steps exceed the camera update interval to verify reduced effective rate
